questions.question: Can the current official PDF, live form, and public competition page be reverified and snapshotted?
Does the user own and intend to use a Canon 5D Mark II, or is that only historical context?
questions.default: Retain Canon EOS 6D Mark I as canonical; do not add inferred gear

questions.question: Can headless browser QA complete outside the managed sandbox after the interrupted run?
Should the public path challenges/arquitectura-en-foco/ be renamed now that the guide is no longer tied to the contest?
questions.default: Keep the path: GitHub Pages cannot send server redirects, and existing links, bookmarks and installed PWAs point at it. Only the visible copy is generalized.

questions.question: Do the estimated scene rows match Lima in the field: window-lit interiors by day (EV 8-10) and darkness away from street lights (upper bound -1)?
questions.default: Keep the stated estimates and their sources in exposure_model.py. Confirm with a metered test frame in each condition on the next field outing and correct the rows if they are off by more than a stop.

questions.question: Should the site's bar and the Sujeto/Hora bar also stay fixed at the top on phones?
questions.default: Keep them fixed only on screens with room for them (40.0625 by 31.25 em, 641 by 500 px at the default text size). On a phone they would cover a fifth to over a third of the screen, so they scroll away there and the bottom bar stays.
